'''Unger Furnace''' was a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] and [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Furnace was a [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of the [[Velocity Mercenaries]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Unger Furnace frequently piloted a [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] in the [[Dathomir system/Legends|Dathomir system]].<ref name="SWG:ItMFC" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TemplateVelocityPilots.png|thumb|right|250px|All possible depictions of Unger Furnace]]
Unger Furnace appeared appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:ItMFC" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Unger Furnace was added to the game with the release of the expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed|''Jump to Lightspeed'']] on [[October 27]], [[2004]].<ref name="SWG:ItMFC" />
